declared difference (truth fix T6, cadence guard): any `Clock.millis(` on the write's line or the 5 above counted
as a cadence guard, so a write of the clock itself (line 8) and a write after a bare `long now = Clock.millis();`
(line 10) were suppressed by their own clock reads. A Clock.millis() read now guards only from a condition that
gates the write: a comparison or if on a line above (directly or through a local assigned from Clock.millis(),
lines 11 and 14), or an if before the setter on its own line; never inside the written value.

@DIR@

WARN  lint-persist-hot-write  @DIR@/BClk.java:10  setRunHours(...) writes non-transient slot 'runHours' reached from changed(), no cadence guard (Clock.millis()/counter) within 5 lines -- integrate in memory, checkpoint on a periodic tick + in stopped(), seed once on start

-- BClk.java --
class BClk {
  static final Property lastRunMs = newProperty(0, 0d, null);
  static final Property runHours = newProperty(0, 0d, null);
  static final Property idleHours = newProperty(0, 0d, null);
  static final Property saveHours = newProperty(0, 0d, null);
  public void changed(Property p, Context cx) { execute(); }
  void execute() {
    setLastRunMs((double) Clock.millis());
    long now = Clock.millis();
    setRunHours(getRunHours() + dt);
    if (now - lastSave > 60000) {
      setSaveHours(getSaveHours() + dt);
    }
    if (Clock.millis() - lastIdle < 60000) return;
    setIdleHours(getIdleHours() + dt);
  }
}
